# kion_project_line_item (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a Kion ProjectLineItem by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kion_project_line_item" "example" {
  # Required
  id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) The ID of the ProjectLineItem to fetch.

### Read-Only

- `category_id` (Number)
- `datecode` (Number)
- `description` (String)
- `funding_source_id` (Number)
- `payer_id` (Number)
- `project_id` (Number)
